title: TimetablePublicationV1
description: A timetable for one academic period from the timetabling system (F-TTB-SIS-01), received by POST /api/v1/timetable-publications (Phase 4 D-24). Each activity names its offering by id, or by module code plus academic year plus period code. An unknown or ambiguous offering rejects the whole publication and the previous one stays current. A publication replaces the activities of each offering it contains; fullPeriod replaces the whole period. Weeks are concrete Monday dates, so no institutional week numbering is needed. Contains no personal data.

sourceVersion.description: The timetabling system's version or export id; unique per source. Re-sending the same version with the same content is a no-op.

activityRef.description: The timetabling system's stable id for the activity

groupSetCode.description: Activities of one offering sharing a group set are alternatives: a student attends one
